_comment: REX Queue Processor Configuration — edit as needed

nemobot._url_note: Points to the REX FastAPI backend — always running. Uses /api/chat which routes through LiteLLM to ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok etc.
nemobot._note: REX backend at port 8000 accepts {message, model} and returns {response}. No external auth needed — it's local.

email._note: To enable email: create a Gmail App Password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords, paste it in app_password, set enabled=true

ai_models._note: Model strings passed to REX /api/chat — must match litellm_proxy.py ALL_MODELS keys.
